verdict.rationale: Brave publishes an official MCP server at github.com/brave/brave-search-mcp-server. It exposes web, local, image, video, news, LLM-context and summarization tools, and first-party guides cover connecting it to Claude Desktop and Claude Cowork on Bedrock. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: An MCP server implementation that integrates the Brave Search API, providing comprehensive search capabilities including web search, local business search, place search, image search, video search, news search, LLM context, and AI-powered summarization.
This guide covers the steps required to enable Brave Search as a tool to be used in the Claude desktop app using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
This guide explains how to integrate Claude Cowork on Amazon Bedrock and the Brave Search MCP Server.
